resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Set to 30 links per month. TinyURL’s current official pricing page defines the Free plan limit as 30 links and describes Links as the number of links that can be shortened each month: https://tinyurl.com/app/pricing. TinyURL also confirms that Free Plan users can use its API: https://tinyurl.com/blog/can-use-api-shorten-links-tinyurl-free/
